title: Zainab Ke Samne
body:
Yeh Karbala mein kya hua Zainab ke saamne,
Zahra ka ghar ujad gaya Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani pila na paayi dam-e-zibh bhai ko,
Sar tan se kar diya juda Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai tadapta reh gaya teeron ki nok par,
Nok-e-sina pe sar chadha Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal mein haaye ghodon se paamaal ho gaya,
Bint-e-Nabi ka laadla Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad-e-Hussain aag laga di khayaam mein,
Ek ek khaima jal gaya Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimon ke saath raakh hua jal ke haaye haaye,
Jhoola bhi sheekhaar ka Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi ke sar ne dekha jo behnon ko be-rida,
Neze se neeche gir gaya Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehra lahu se bhar gaya Zahra ke laal ka,
Patthar jabeen pe jab laga Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maari chhadi Yazid ne munh par Hussain ke,
Phir tasht khoon se bhar gaya Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maanga Sakina Bibi ne paani jo Shimr se,
Maara tamaancha zor ka Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhakka kuchh is tarah diya Abid ko Shimr ne,
Beemaar munh ke bal gira Zainab ke saamne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shamshad tere nauhe ko sun kar bahisht mein,
Saara gharana ro pada Zainab ke saamne.
author: Maulana Shamshad Ahmad Gopalpuri
